title: Run Entropy Summaries CI Hook (with v1.1 schema checks)
abstract: Extends the CI hook to enforce v1.1 schema and types; logs to ci_hook.log and writes ci_hook_schema_report.json.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries')
import ci_hook
if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = ci_hook.run()
    print(json.dumps({"status":"ok","checked": out.get("total"), "ok": out.get("ok"), "bad": out.get("bad"), "report_txt": out.get("report_txt"), "report_json": out.get("report_json")}))
